Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time to connect. We’d like to run a 45–60 minute interactive API walkthrough that covers:
- Quick console tour (10 min)
- Live API key exchange and first request (20 min)
- Best-practice routing / batching tips (10 min)
- Q&A + next steps (10–20 min)

We noticed your preference for morning slots. We have two compact windows this week that would fit an engineer-heavy schedule:
- Thursday 12/03, 11:00–12:00 PT
- Friday 12/04, 08:00–09:00 PT (tight window)

Could you confirm which of those you'd prefer? If neither works, share two alternate 60-min blocks and we’ll do our best.

One ask before the session: can you provision a test API key with the same policy you use in staging (read/write tokens with the same routing rules)? If you can’t create a key, we’ll use a sandbox mode but the live key lets us validate your routing and KV caching behaviour end-to-end. If you’d rather not share credentials over email, we can accept a short-lived key via the Drive link (recommended).

Attached is a short agenda and a 1-page prep checklist. Ben (cc’d) will run the demo; Tessa will handle the ops handoff if you want a short runbook transfer at the end.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
